entries.title: About Àkàndé Voice Assistant: Mission & Architecture
entries.content: Skip to main content About Àkàndé Voice Assistant: Mission & Architecture Discover the vision, open-source architecture, and engineering principles driving Àkàndé Voice Assistant. Our Vision Àkàndé was born from a fundamental belief: modern voice interfaces should be responsive, private, and deeply intelligent. By combining OpenAI's GPT models with a high-performance Python runtime and SQLite caching architecture, Àkàndé delivers near-instant response times while respecting user data confidentiality. Open-Source Innovation Released under dual Apache-2.0 and MIT open-source licensing, Àkàndé empowers developers worldwide to inspect, extend, and integrate voice capabilities into their own tools, services, and devices. Privacy-First Engineering Unlike conventional cloud assistants that transmit raw audio and telemetric profiles to third-party ad networks, Àkàndé processes queries deterministically, utilizing local SQLite caching to minimize external API overhead and ensure full data governance.\n Back to the top ↑ ✕ Type to search...

entries.title: Accessibility Statement | Àkàndé Voice Assistant
entries.content: Skip to main content Accessibility Statement | Àkàndé Voice Assistant Comprehensive accessibility statement for Àkàndé: WCAG 2.2 Level AA / AAA conformance, keyboard navigability, and assistive technology verification. 1. Conformance Standards Àkàndé Voice Assistant is engineered to conform with WCAG 2.2 Level AA and AAA criteria, Section 508, and European standard EN 301 549 across all desktop and mobile interfaces. Perceivable Maintains a minimum 7:1 contrast ratio across Light and Dark themes, with rich descriptive alt text for all interface icons and diagrams. Operable 100% operable via keyboard alone with visible focus rings, zero keyboard traps, and instant skip links. Understandable Clear semantic typography, predictable navigation landmarks, and descriptive validation notices. Robust Tested with Apple VoiceOver, NVDA, and JAWS screen readers with complete WAI-ARIA landmark support. 2. Feedback & Contact If you experience any accessibility barrier, please reach out via our Contact Form. We target responses within 2 business days.\n Back to the top ↑ ✕ Type to search...

entries.title: Frequently Asked Questions | Questions? Answers. | Àkàndé
entries.content: Skip to main content Questions? Answers. Expand all What is Àkàndé? Àkàndé is an innovative voice assistant engineered to boost productivity and simplify tasks. It excels in natural language understanding and response generation, using Python and OpenAI's GPT models. Features like PDF summary generation and a smart caching mechanism set it apart, making it a powerful tool for enhancing digital workflows. Explore all features ❯ How does Àkàndé's natural language understanding work? Powered by OpenAI's GPT models, Àkàndé interprets human queries with remarkable accuracy. This advanced natural language understanding enables it to deliver relevant, contextually appropriate responses, facilitating more natural and meaningful interactions between humans and machines. Learn about the architecture ❯ What is the PDF summary generation feature? Àkàndé's PDF summary generation feature allows users to create succinct summaries of their voice interactions. These summaries include a question header, the AI-generated response, and an accompanying logo, making it perfect for documenting meeting decisions or compiling notes efficiently. See document generation ❯ Can Àkàndé store and retrieve past queries and responses? Yes, thanks to a sophisticated SQLite-based caching system, Àkàndé can store and recall past queries and responses. This capability enhances response times for repeated queries and decreases dependence on continuous API calls, leading to quicker and more efficient interactions. View technology stack ❯ What are some applications of Àkàndé? Àkàndé is incredibly versatile, suitable for both personal and professional contexts. It aids in managing schedules, setting reminders, conducting research, and facilitating decision-making processes. Its proficiency in handling complex queries and generating human-like responses makes it an indispensable tool across various tasks. Explore use cases ❯ What can I do with Àkàndé? With Àkàndé, you can harness the power of advanced AI to enhance your productivity and streamline your tasks. Use it to manage your schedule, set reminders, perform in-depth research, and facilitate decision-making with ease. Àkàndé's versatility makes it perfect for summarizing meetings, generating reports, and even understanding and executing complex commands. Discover capabilities ❯ How do I use Àkàndé? Using Àkàndé is straightforward and intuitive, designed for ease of interaction through voice commands. Start by activating Àkàndé with a simple voice command or click, then speak your query or command clearly. Àkàndé processes your input using advanced natural language understanding, allowing you to ask questions, command tasks, or request summaries. Get developer support ❯ How does Àkàndé ensure user privacy and data security? Àkàndé prioritizes user privacy and data security by employing advanced data handling and encryption methods. It uses secure API key validation and processes data on-device to ensure your information stays private and secure. These measures prevent unauthorized access and ensure that your interactions with Àkàndé are not linked to your personal identity. Read Privacy Policy ❯ What makes Àkàndé's PDF summary generation unique? Àkàndé's PDF summary generation stands out by offering customizability and incorporating unique branding elements like logos. Unlike standard voice assistant summarizations, it allows for personalized summary formats, including detailed headers and contextual responses, making it an invaluable tool for both personal record-keeping and professional documentation. View PDF capabilities ❯ How can developers customize Àkàndé for their specific needs? Developers can tailor Àkàndé through environment variables for configuration, such as adjusting the default model, cache size, and expiration parameters. This flexibility ensures Àkàndé can be adapted to various applications, enhancing functionality and user experience in bespoke environments. Read developer docs ❯ What languages and accents does Àkàndé support? Àkàndé is designed to support a wide range of languages and accents, offering broad accessibility and understanding. This capability ensures users from various linguistic backgrounds can interact with Àkàndé seamlessly, making it a versatile tool for global use. View language support ❯ How to integrate Àkàndé with other applications or services? Àkàndé

entries.title: Key Features & Capabilities | Àkàndé Voice Assistant
entries.content: Skip to main content Key Features & Capabilities | Àkàndé Voice Assistant Explore the cutting-edge capabilities of Àkàndé: Natural Language Processing, PDF Summary Generation, SQLite Caching, and Inclusivity. 1. Natural Language Understanding Powered by state-of-the-art GPT models, Àkàndé accurately interprets conversational nuances, ambiguous prompts, and multi-step commands, translating complex voice queries into actionable insights. 2. Automated PDF Summaries Instantly generate publication-ready PDF meeting summaries, complete with structured headers, action items, executive bullet points, and branded formatting for frictionless team sharing. 3. Smart SQLite Caching Sub-millisecond query retrieval for repeated prompts eliminates redundant API latency, reduces operational bandwidth, and drastically lowers external inference costs. 4. Privacy-First Architecture Zero third-party tracking, zero analytics pixels, and local configuration ensure that your executive voice interactions and proprietary data remain strictly confidential. 5. Universal Accessibility Engineered from the ground up to comply with WCAG 2.2 Level AAA standards, featuring full keyboard accessibility, ARIA landmark support, and high-contrast color tokenization.\n Back to the top ↑ ✕ Type to search...

entries.title: Built with Static Site Generator (SSG)
entries.content: Skip to main content Built with Static Site Generator (SSG) Delivering blazing speed, zero client-side tracking, and pristine accessibility out of the box with Rust Static Site Generator. 1. Sub-Millisecond TTFB Performance Every page is pre-rendered into static HTML at build time, eliminating database latency and runtime server overhead. Assets are delivered through global Edge CDN nodes with HTTP/2 and Brotli compression. 2. Absolute Privacy by Design Static Site Generator does not inject tracking scripts, analytics cookies, or behavioral telemetry. Your browsing activity remains 100% private. 3. Cryptographic Subresource Integrity (SRI) Every stylesheet, script, and font is secured using SHA-384 cryptographic integrity hashes, ensuring complete immunity against supply-chain tampering.\n Back to the top ↑ ✕ Type to search...

entries.title: Privacy Policy | Àkàndé Voice Assistant
entries.content: Skip to main content Privacy Policy | Àkàndé Voice Assistant Official privacy policy for Àkàndé: zero tracking cookies, local preference storage, and UK / EU GDPR data protection rights. 1. Zero-Tracking Architecture Àkàndé operates under strict privacy by design: we do not collect personal tracking metrics, we do not utilize advertising pixels, and we do not sell data. Local storage is strictly limited to your preferred theme mode (light/dark). 2. Data Subject Rights (UK & EU GDPR) Under UK GDPR, EU GDPR 2016/679, and the Data Protection Act 2018, you maintain statutory rights of access, rectification, erasure, and data portability. To exercise these rights, submit an inquiry via our Contact Form. 3. Security Standards All interactions utilize TLS 1.3 encryption, Subresource Integrity (SRI) SHA-384 cryptographic hashing, and Content Security Policies to protect against client-side injection.\n Back to the top ↑ ✕ Type to search...
